id.instruksi: Lihat langitnya, lalu sentuh benda yang harus dibawa robot keluar rumah.
id.t-cerah1: Langit cerah, matahari terik. Mana yang dipakai?
id.t-hujan1: Langit gelap, hujan turun. Mana yang dipakai?
id.t-cerah2: Matahari bersinar terang. Mana yang dipakai?
id.t-hujan2: Tetes hujan jatuh dari langit. Mana yang dipakai?
id.t-angin: Angin bertiup kencang, daun beterbangan. Mana yang dimainkan?
id.t-cerah3: Siang hari panas sekali di lapangan. Mana yang dipakai?
id.t-cerah4: Tidak ada awan, matahari bersinar di atas kepala. Mana yang dipakai?
id.t-hujan3: Hujan deras, jalanan jadi basah. Mana yang dipakai?
id.t-hujan4: Gerimis turun rintik-rintik. Mana yang dipakai?
id.t-hujan5: Tik-tik-tik, bunyi hujan di atap. Mana yang dipakai?
id.t-angin2: Angin bertiup kencang di lapangan luas. Mana yang dimainkan?

en.instruksi: Look at the sky, then touch what robot should take before going out.
en.t-cerah1: Sunny sky, the sun is hot. Which one do we use?
en.t-hujan1: Dark sky, the rain is falling. Which one do we use?
en.t-cerah2: The sun is shining bright. Which one do we use?
en.t-hujan2: Raindrops are falling from the sky. Which one do we use?
en.t-angin: The wind is blowing hard, leaves are flying. Which one do we play with?
en.t-cerah3: It is very hot at noon in the field. Which one do we use?
en.t-cerah4: No clouds, the sun is shining overhead. Which one do we use?
en.t-hujan3: Heavy rain, the road is wet. Which one do we use?
en.t-hujan4: A light drizzle is falling. Which one do we use?
en.t-hujan5: Pitter-patter, rain on the roof. Which one do we use?
en.t-angin2: A strong wind blows across the wide field. Which one do we play with?

itemCount.keterangan: jumlah pilihan: 2 (payung, topi) → 3 (tambah layang-layang untuk langit berangin)
